title: fix(lint): `objectstack validate` refuses a blank structural `condition`, the rule `registerFlow` already applies (#17495)
body:
Closes #17495

Clause-②: no

`validateStackExpressions` — the pass behind `objectstack validate` — reported
**nothing** for a structural `condition` that is blank after trimming, at either
node slot (a `start` node's trigger gate, a `decision` node's predicate) and on
an edge. #17322 / PR #17491 rebound `AutomationEngine.registerFlow` to the edge
door's non-blank rule, so the same value now stops the flow registering at boot
behind a single `warn` line. An author ran validate, got a clean bill, deployed,
and the trigger was never armed.

`checkStructuralCondition` gains the second gate the engine's copy already has,
in the same position (after the shape refusal, before the CEL pass), asking the
same **imported** rule: `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema`, which
`FlowEdgeSchema.condition` has composed since #15807. Not a second hand-written
notion of "blank" — that is the drift the #15662 campaign built one shared
refusal to prevent — so the finding carries the spec's published
`EVALUATED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED` sentence verbatim and the three doors
cannot answer differently.

## Readings

Re-measured at claim time on `d46deba195`, ⛔ not taken from the dispatch:

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| #17322 | **closed** (completed) 2026-09-10T18:17:22Z |
| PR #17491 | **merged** 2026-09-10T18:17:21Z |
| `(#17491)` in `git log --oneline -400 origin/main` | **1** (control `(#17637)`: **1**) |
| `evaluatedSourceRefusal` in `engine.ts` at the base commit | **2** occurrences — the runtime refusal really is on `main` |
| `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema.safeParse('   ')` | `success: false` |

One probe, both structural node slots at once, before → after:

| probe | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `condition: '   '` at the start gate **and** the decision predicate | **0** | **2** |
| `condition: ''` at both | **0** | **2** |
| ⭐ CONTROL — brace trap at both | **2** | **2** |
| ⭐ CONTROL — `ast`-only envelope at both | **2** | **2** |
| ⭐ CONTROL — valid CEL at both | **0** | **0** |
| `condition: '   '` on an edge | 0 | 1 |

The control trio is what makes the two zeros mean anything: each drives the same
probe over the same two slots, each is answered by a *different* pass (the CEL
pass, the shape pass, nothing), and each is unmoved by this change — so the
probe demonstrably reaches both slots and still discriminates. Without them a
`0` proves only that nothing was measured. All three are pinned as tests.

## The two pins are RE-JUDGED IN PLACE, never deleted

Copying the shape PR #17491 used for its own two stale pins.

1. `validate-expressions.test.ts` — *"a whitespace-only STRING is untouched —
   ruled correct, not a defect"*. That `toHaveLength(0)` was deliberate: #15662
   ruled the blank string correct **on the ground that author time and run time
   agreed about it**. #15807 removed that ground at the edge door and #17322
   removed it at the node door. The case is **flipped in place** with the reason
   written into it, and it now also pins that the blank refusal and #15662's
   shape refusal stayed **distinct** — exactly what the registration-side pin
   does.
2. `lint-flow-patterns.test.ts` (the line the card names) — the
   `flow-inert-node-condition` zero **still stands and is kept**: that rule is
   about a key *nothing reads*, and it never had an opinion on blankness. What
   changed is that the pin was readable as "validate says nothing about a blank
   condition", which is now a false record. It is re-judged in place with that
   reasoning, plus a cross-site assertion pinning where the refusal actually
   lives — so the zero can never be read as silence again.

⭐ A pin removed leaves no trace that the behaviour was once deliberate; a pin
re-judged says what changed and why.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` — **101 files / 3735 passed**, 5 skipped, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` — exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` + test-layer check).
- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint^...' build` — exit 0 (dependency closure).
- Repo-wide `eslint . --no-inline-config --format json` — **6623 files linted**, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Not a narrowed run: the population is eslint's own, read from its config.
- Derived gate families (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 4-path change set): **59 derived, 56 run green, 3 NOT MEASURED** (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:type-check-debt` each exit **3** — PREREQUISITE NOT MET, they read a whole-repo `dist/`; that build is CI's). 0 red. Reconciled with `--ran` carrying exit codes.
- **Reverse verification** (fix committed first, `git checkout HEAD -- THE_PATH` restore under a trap): the gate mutated out on disk — anchor `1 → 0`, injected marker `1` — and the two test files went **8 failed / 438 passed**; restored byte-identically (`git hash-object` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty) and back to **446 passed**.

## Clause-② and the changeset, both measured

**`Clause-②: no`**, measured on the delivered diff rather than asserted:

- **Path limb** — `SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS` is `packages/spec/src/**`; this diff touches `packages/lint/src` and `.changeset` only.
- **Widening tells** — no schema key, no closed-set member, no published export, no registry entry is added. The rule is *imported*; the contract itself is untouched.
- **Accept-set census** — 23 authored shapes at all three structural slots, run twice on one tree (once at HEAD, once with the gate ablated). Exactly **6 rows move**, every one of them the blank family: `'   '`, `''`, `'\t'`, `'\n'`, `{dialect:'cel',source:'   '}`, `{dialect:'cel',source:''}`. The other **17** are byte-identical, including every accepting shape (bare CEL padded and multiline, all three envelope spellings, absent, `null`). The narrowing is the ruled shape and nothing else, and the contract that rules it was decided in #15807 and applied in #17322 — this PR is the third door catching up, not a new decision.

**Changeset owed, and written** (⛔ not skipped): `@objectstack/lint` publishes `files: ["dist", …]`, and the new refusal is measured **in** the shipped bundles — `evaluatedSourceRefusal` appears 2× in `dist/index.js` and 2× in `dist/index.cjs` (positive control: `validateStackExpressions` 4× in `dist/index.js`). It is a `minor` with a BREAKING banner and an ADR-0087 disposition, mirroring PR #17491's; `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset` all pass on it.

## 验收备注

- **Declared deviation from the dispatch's file list.** The dispatch said to touch only `validate-expressions.ts` and `lint-flow-patterns.test.ts`. The pin that actually recorded this pass's silence is in **`validate-expressions.test.ts`** (*"a whitespace-only STRING is untouched"*) — the card cited `lint-flow-patterns.test.ts:1279`, which pins `lintFlowPatterns`, a different rule family whose zero this change does not move. Landing without editing `validate-expressions.test.ts` was impossible: that assertion becomes false. Both pins are re-judged; the new behavioural tests live beside the pass they test. The changeset is the fourth file.
- The `#5017` meta-guard needed one entry: the new local `blankRefusal` is excused as plumbing beside `shapeRefusal`, with the same argument (its keys are the helper's own `{ message, source }`, never metadata keys).
- Out of scope and untouched, as dispatched: the three `packages/spec` siblings (#17493, which also owns widening that ADR-0087 entry's `surface` to `config.condition`), `packages/services/service-automation` (the reference, not the target), and the three neighbours the card judged not duplicates (#16910 / #17305 / #17069).
- The **evaluator** half of #15662's ruling is deliberately untouched: a condition already stored blank still answers `false`. What moved is that it can no longer be authored past validate.
